groups.title: Calibration, Repair and Engineering
groups.summary: On-site welding machine calibration, machine and torch repair, welder testing, training and WPS/PQR development.
groups.intro: Onsite calibration offers a quick and easy way to get your equipment certified while reducing the risk of damage during transportation. Calibrating compares the weld outputs, typically voltage and amperage, on a piece of welding equipment to the indications of a certified test instrument, to determine whether the equipment is within the tolerances of the applicable standard. In 2024 we opened a welding machine repair facility in the Northwest Houston area.

about.title: Old school values are never out of date.
text: Houston Welders Supply is an independently owned and operated company that provides industrial gases, welding supplies and technical expertise throughout the Houston and Beaumont areas. We have taken pride in focusing on top notch customer service since 2015.

We are relationship driven, directly impacting the success of our customers through reliable and innovative solutions. With over 250 years of combined industry experience, quality service, competitive pricing and trustworthy technical expertise, we are an essential partner in the welding industry.

In 2024 we launched two new locations: a Beaumont branch for the Southeast Texas market and a welding machine repair facility in the Northwest Houston area. In 2025 Houston Welders Supply was selected for the Aggie 100 for a second consecutive year.
